title: Expansion Joint and Other Accessories
intro: Ethios provides components essential in modern construction, designed to absorb and accommodate the natural movements of buildings and structures caused by temperature changes, load variations, or seismic activity. These joints prevent the formation of cracks, water seepage, and other structural damages that can compromise safety and performance over time. Along with the expansion joints, a wide range of accessories are available to support proper installation and long-term functionality.

products.name: Backer Rod 6MM
products.description: 6 mm Backer Rod is a closed-cell polyethylene foam ideal for narrow joints in window glazing, doors, and partitions. It prevents sealant adhesion at the base, ensures proper tooling, and provides insulation. Supplied in custom lengths, with excellent flexibility, and resistant to water, oil, and chemicals

products.name: Backer Rod 10MM
products.description: 10 mm Backer Rod is a compressible, closed-cell PE foam ideal for sealant backing in medium width joints, including pre-cast units and pavement repairs. It ensures optimal sealant bond break and wetting. Chemically inert, non-staining, and supplied in dark grey with 32 kg/m³ density.

products.name: Backer Rod 20MM
products.description: 20 mm Backer Rod provides an effective bond breaker and insulator for expansion joints in construction, partitions, and log homes. Made of closed-cell polyethylene foam, it fits joint widths of 15–20 mm, with excellent resistance to water, oil, and most solvents. Flexible and easy to install.

products.name: Backer Rod 30MM
products.description: 30 mm Backer Rod is designed for wide construction joints, glazing, and infrastructure works, offering high compressibility and sealant support. It prevents three-sided adhesion and maintains joint insulation. Resistant to chemicals and supplied in rolls with tensile strength of 50 PSI.

products.name: EPE Sheet - 25 MM
products.description: EPE Sheet – 25 mm is a semi-closed cell polyethylene foam ideal for light-duty construction applications such as expansion joint filler, tile cushioning, and surface protection. It offers excellent flexibility, compressibility, and water resistance, with a density of 28–30 kg/m³, thermal conductivity of 0.033 W/m·K, and working temperature from -40°C to +75°C.

products.name: EPE Sheet - 75 MM
products.description: EPE Sheet – 75 mm is a high-thickness polyethylene foam designed for heavy-duty construction site needs like slab edge protection, expansion joints, and vibration isolation. It provides superior compressibility, chemical resistance, and insulation, with density 28–30 kg/m³, thermal conductivity 0.033 W/m·K, and a usage range of -40°C to +75°C.

products.name: SikaSwell®-912
products.description: SIKASWELL®-912 is a one-component, moisture-curing swelling paste sealant that expands up to 250% upon contact with water, forming a watertight barrier in construction joints, pipe penetrations, and concrete interfaces. It bonds to concrete, steel, and plastics, and offers chemical and saline resistance. Supplied in 310 ml cartridges, with a shelf life of 9 months, and suitable for applications between +5°C to +40°C.

products.name: Sikadur®-32 LP
products.description: Sikadur®-32 LP IN is a two-component, solvent-free epoxy bonding agent ideal for structural bonding of concrete, stone, metals, masonry, wood, and more. It offers high mechanical strength, long pot life, and superior adhesion even on damp substrates. Supplied in 6 kg and 30 kg kits, with a shelf life of 12 months, and compliant with ASTM C881-78 Type II, Grade 2, Class B+C.

products.name: Chryso® Swellseal
products.description: CHRYSO® SWELLSEAL is a hydro-swelling joint sealant strip designed to expand up to 3 times its volume upon water contact, effectively sealing construction joints, cold joints, pipe penetrations, and precast concrete elements. It offers reversible swelling, exceptional flexibility, and chemical resistance. Supplied in sizes like 20×5 mm, 20×6 mm, 20×10 mm, and 10×3 mm, with a shelf life of 12 months.

products.name: Dr. Fixit Polybar Plus
products.description: POLYBAR+ 20x5 mm is a hydrophilic waterstop made from synthetic rubber, designed for sealing construction joints in concrete structures. It expands up to 500% in rainwater and 400% in concrete water, providing durable watertight protection even after multiple wet-dry cycles. Resistant to chemicals and weather, it performs in temperatures from -20°C to +75°C and is supplied in 10 m rolls (5 rolls per box).

products.name: PVC Water Stopper
products.description: High-Performance Joint Seal Strip – 200 mm × 8 mm is engineered to protect concrete structures by sealing construction and expansion joints against water ingress. It delivers excellent tensile strength (13 MPa), 300% elongation, and high tear resistance (38.6 N/mm), with low water absorption and superior flexibility. Supplied in 25-meter rolls, ideal for slabs, basements, tanks, and retaining walls.

products.name: Dr. Fixit Epoxy Bonding
products.description: Dr. Fixit Epoxy Bonding Agent is a two-component, solvent-free epoxy adhesive formulated for bonding old to new concrete, bricks, tiles, and steel components. With excellent adhesion, chemical resistance, and a pot life of 30–50 minutes, it forms a high-strength, moisture-tolerant bond. Supplied in 1 kg packs, with a shelf life of 24 months, and conforms to ASTM C881 & BS 6319 standards.

products.name: Technonicol Ultraflex
products.description: TECHNONICOL ULTRAFLEX SA 7000-X is a self-adhesive, carrier-less SBS-modified bitumen membrane designed for waterproofing foundations and protecting against radon ingress. With high elongation (≥800%), excellent self-healing, and dimensional stability, it ensures long-lasting waterproofing in tough site conditions. Supplied in rolls of 1 m x 20 m with 1.5 mm thickness and 12-month shelf life, it performs reliably even at temperatures down to -15°C.

products.name: Vapor Barrier
products.description: TECHNONICOL VAPOR BARRIER is a high-performance self-adhesive SBS-modified bitumen membrane reinforced with a glass net and protected by aluminum foil. Ideal for flat roof insulation systems, it ensures exceptional vapor control, peel resistance (≥50 N/50mm), and tensile strength (600±120 N/50mm), even in extreme temperatures down to -25°C. Supplied in rolls of 1.08 m × 50 m, with a shelf life of 12 months.
